text_blocks.snippet: Immunotherapy, particularly checkpoint inhibitors, has significantly improved the success rate of treating advanced melanoma. For metastatic melanoma, a combination of checkpoint inhibitors like nivolumab and ipilimumab has shown a 10-year survival rate of around 50%. While individual results vary, the introduction of immunotherapy has transformed melanoma from a nearly universally fatal disease to one where long-term survival and even cure are possible.
